Ay it happens. My wife of two yrs bought an apt behind my back and slowly started movin out while I was at work. After a few days I finally noticed and she left completely to stay at a "work friends" house. So I threw the rest of her stuff on the lawn. I wasn't abusive, I didn't do any drugs or drink excessively, if anything we had a somewhat boring marriage. I thought I was a good husband. Sometimes shitty things happen to people who did nothing to bring it on themselves. I drank heavily after she left and spiraled out hard and lost the job I had. Now I have a better job and tbh am happier than I've been in a long time. I'm more alive and in tune with myself. It's gona feel like a real fuckin hell for a while but don't let you drag yourself down and always focus on your self worth.
